sentence_stem: If the company had invested in training,
correct_completion: its staff would be more productive now.
full_sentence: If the company had invested in training, its staff would be more productive now.
acceptable_variants: its staff would now work more efficiently.
its productivity would be higher today.

options.text: so its staff would be more productive now.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a real result, not a hypothetical one. The sentence needs a result clause for an unreal condition.

options.text: its staff would be more productive now.

options.why_wrong: This describes the cost of the training, not the result of the hypothetical situation.

options.text: it had invested in training yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the condition's content and does not give a result.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past condition with present result
explanation: A mixed conditional links an unreal past condition (had invested) with an unreal present result (would be). The main clause must describe the present consequence, using would plus the base verb.
translation: Якби компанія інвестувала в навчання, її працівники зараз були б продуктивнішими.
